import FLT.DivisionAlgebra.Finiteness

/-

# Definition of automorphic forms on a totally definite quaternion algebra

-/

suppress_compilation

variable (F : Type*) [Field F] [NumberField F] --[NumberField.IsTotallyReal F]

variable (D : Type*) [Ring D] [Algebra F D] --[IsCentralSimple F D] [FiniteDimensional F D]

namespace TotallyDefiniteQuaternionAlgebra

-- noncomputable example : D →+* (D ⊗[F] FiniteAdeleRing (𝓞 F) F) :=
--   Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeftRingHom

open scoped TensorProduct NumberField

open DedekindDomain

abbrev Dfx := (D ⊗[F] (FiniteAdeleRing (𝓞 F) F))ˣ

variable {F D} in
noncomputable abbrev incl₁ : Dˣ →* Dfx F D :=
  Units.map Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeftRingHom.toMonoidHom

noncomputable abbrev incl₂ : (FiniteAdeleRing (𝓞 F) F)ˣ →* Dfx F D :=
  Units.map Algebra.TensorProduct.rightAlgebra.algebraMap.toMonoidHom

/-!
This definition is made in mathlib-generality but is *not* the definition of an automorphic
form unless Dˣ is compact mod centre at infinity. This hypothesis will be true if `D` is a
totally definite quaternion algebra.
-/
structure AutomorphicForm
  -- defined over R
  (R : Type*) [CommRing R]
  -- of weight W
  (W : Type*) [AddCommGroup W] [Module R W] [MulAction Dˣ W]
  -- and level U
  (U : Subgroup (D ⊗[F] (FiniteAdeleRing (𝓞 F) F))ˣ)
  -- and character χ
  (χ : (FiniteAdeleRing (𝓞 F) F)ˣ →* R) where
  -- definition
  toFun : (D ⊗[F] (FiniteAdeleRing (𝓞 F) F))ˣ → W
  left_invt : ∀ (δ : Dˣ) (g : (D ⊗[F] (FiniteAdeleRing (𝓞 F) F))ˣ),
    toFun (incl₁ δ * g) = δ • (toFun g)
  has_character : ∀ (g : (D ⊗[F] (FiniteAdeleRing (𝓞 F) F))ˣ) (z : (FiniteAdeleRing (𝓞 F) F)ˣ),
    toFun (g * incl₂ F D z) = χ z • toFun g
  right_invt : ∀ (g : (D ⊗[F] (FiniteAdeleRing (𝓞 F) F))ˣ),
    ∀ u ∈ U, toFun (g * u) = toFun g

namespace AutomorphicForm

-- defined over R
variable  (R : Type*) [CommRing R]
  -- weight
  (W : Type*) [AddCommGroup W] [Module R W] [DistribMulAction Dˣ W]
  -- NB actions of Dˣ and R should commute
  -- level
  (U : Subgroup (D ⊗[F] (FiniteAdeleRing (𝓞 F) F))ˣ) -- subgroup should be compact and open
  -- character
  (χ : (FiniteAdeleRing (𝓞 F) F)ˣ →* R)

variable {F D R W U χ}

instance : CoeFun (AutomorphicForm F D R W U χ) (fun _ ↦ Dfx F D → W) where
  coe := toFun

attribute [coe] AutomorphicForm.toFun

@[ext]
theorem ext (φ ψ : AutomorphicForm F D R W U χ) (h : ∀ x, φ x = ψ x) : φ = ψ := by
  cases φ; cases ψ; simp only [mk.injEq]; ext; apply h

def zero : (AutomorphicForm F D R W U χ) where
  toFun := 0
  left_invt δ _ := by simp
  has_character _ z := by simp
  right_invt _ u _ := by simp

instance : Zero (AutomorphicForm F D R W U χ) where
  zero := zero

@[simp]
theorem zero_apply (x : (D ⊗[F] (FiniteAdeleRing (𝓞 F) F))ˣ) :
    (0 : AutomorphicForm F D R W U χ) x = 0 := rfl

def neg (φ : AutomorphicForm F D R W U χ) : AutomorphicForm F D R W U χ where
  toFun x := - φ x
  left_invt δ g := by simp [left_invt]
  has_character g z := by simp [has_character]
  right_invt g u hu := by simp_all [right_invt]

instance : Neg (AutomorphicForm F D R W U χ) where
  neg := neg

@[simp, norm_cast]
theorem neg_apply (φ : AutomorphicForm F D R W U χ) (x : (D ⊗[F] (FiniteAdeleRing (𝓞 F) F))ˣ) :
    (-φ : AutomorphicForm F D R W U χ) x = -(φ x) := rfl

instance add (φ ψ : AutomorphicForm F D R W U χ) : AutomorphicForm F D R W U χ where
  toFun x := φ x + ψ x
  left_invt := by simp [left_invt]
  has_character := by simp [has_character]
  right_invt := by simp_all [right_invt]

instance : Add (AutomorphicForm F D R W U χ) where
  add := add

@[simp, norm_cast]
theorem add_apply (φ ψ : AutomorphicForm F D R W U χ) (x : (D ⊗[F] (FiniteAdeleRing (𝓞 F) F))ˣ) :
    (φ + ψ) x = (φ x) + (ψ x) := rfl

instance addCommGroup : AddCommGroup (AutomorphicForm F D R W U χ) where
  add := (· + ·)
  add_assoc := by intros; ext; simp [add_assoc];
  zero := 0
  zero_add := by intros; ext; simp
  add_zero := by intros; ext; simp
  nsmul := nsmulRec
  neg := (-·)
  zsmul := zsmulRec
  neg_add_cancel := by intros; ext; simp
  add_comm := by intros; ext; simp [add_comm]

-- from this point we need the Dˣ-action on W to be R-linear
variable [SMulCommClass R Dˣ W]

def smul (r : R) (φ : AutomorphicForm F D R W U χ) :
    AutomorphicForm F D R W U χ where
      toFun g := r • φ g
      left_invt := by simp [left_invt, smul_comm]
      has_character g z := by simp only [has_character, smul_comm r]
      right_invt := by simp_all [right_invt]

instance : SMul R (AutomorphicForm F D R W U χ) where
  smul := smul

lemma smul_apply (r : R) (φ : AutomorphicForm F D R W U χ) (g : (D ⊗[F] FiniteAdeleRing (𝓞 F) F)ˣ) :
    (r • φ) g = r • (φ g) := rfl

instance module : Module R (AutomorphicForm F D R W U χ) where
  one_smul g := by exact?

/--
`rfl : a = a` is the unique constructor of the equality type. This is the
same as `Eq.refl` except that it takes `a` implicitly instead of explicitly.

This is a more powerful theorem than it may appear at first, because although
the statement of the theorem is `a = a`, Lean will allow anything that is
definitionally equal to that type. So, for instance, `2 + 2 = 4` is proven in
Lean by `rfl`, because both sides are the same up to definitional equality.
-/
@[match_pattern] def rfl {α : Sort u} {a : α} : Eq a a := Eq.refl a

form unless Dˣ is compact mod centre at infinity. This hypothesis will be true if `D` is a
totally definite quaternion algebra.

  -- defined over R
  (R : Type*) [CommRing R]
  -- of weight W
  (W : Type*) [AddCommGroup W] [Module R W] [MulAction Dˣ W]
  -- and level U
  (U : Subgroup (D ⊗[F] (FiniteAdeleRing (𝓞 F) F))ˣ)
  -- and character χ

  -- definition

# Definition of automorphic forms on a totally definite quaternion algebra

namespace TotallyDefiniteQuaternionAlgebra

-- noncomputable example : D →+* (D ⊗[F] FiniteAdeleRing (𝓞 F) F) :=
--   Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeftRingHom

open scoped TensorProduct NumberField

open DedekindDomain

abbrev Dfx := (D ⊗[F] (FiniteAdeleRing (𝓞 F) F))ˣ

variable {F D} in
noncomputable abbrev incl₁ : Dˣ →* Dfx F D :=
  Units.map Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeftRingHom.toMonoidHom

noncomputable abbrev incl₂ : (FiniteAdeleRing (𝓞 F) F)ˣ →* Dfx F D :=
  Units.map Algebra.TensorProduct.rightAlgebra.algebraMap.toMonoidHom

/-!
This definition is made in mathlib-generality but is *not* the definition of an automorphic
form unless Dˣ is compact mod centre at infinity. This hypothesis will be true if `D` is a
totally definite quaternion algebra.

structure AutomorphicForm
  -- defined over R

  (W : Type*) [AddCommGroup W] [Module R W] [MulAction Dˣ W]
  -- and level U
  (U : Subgroup (D ⊗[F] (FiniteAdeleRing (𝓞 F) F))ˣ)
  -- and character χ
  (χ : (FiniteAdeleRing (𝓞 F) F)ˣ →* R) where
  -- definition
  toFun : (D ⊗[F] (FiniteAdeleRing (𝓞 F) F))ˣ → W
  left_invt : ∀ (δ : Dˣ) (g : (D ⊗[F] (FiniteAdeleRing (𝓞 F) F))ˣ),
    toFun (incl₁ δ * g) = δ • (toFun g)
  has_character : ∀ (g : (D ⊗[F] (FiniteAdeleRing (𝓞 F) F))ˣ) (z : (FiniteAdeleRing (𝓞 F) F)ˣ),
    toFun (g * incl₂ F D z) = χ z • toFun g
  right_invt : ∀ (g : (D ⊗[F] (FiniteAdeleRing (𝓞 F) F))ˣ),
    ∀ u ∈ U, toFun (g * u) = toFun g

import FLT.DivisionAlgebra.Finiteness

/-

# Definition of automorphic forms on a totally definite quaternion algebra

-/

suppress_compilation

variable (F : Type*) [Field F] [NumberField F] --[NumberField.IsTotallyReal F]

variable (D : Type*) [Ring D] [Algebra F D] --[IsCentralSimple F D] [FiniteDimensional F D]

namespace TotallyDefiniteQuaternionAlgebra

-- noncomputable example : D →+* (D ⊗[F] FiniteAdeleRing (𝓞 F) F) :=
--   Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeftRingHom

open scoped TensorProduct NumberField

open DedekindDomain

abbrev Dfx := (D ⊗[F] (FiniteAdeleRing (𝓞 F) F))ˣ

variable {F D} in
noncomputable abbrev incl₁ : Dˣ →* Dfx F D :=
  Units.map Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeftRingHom.toMonoidHom

noncomputable abbrev incl₂ : (FiniteAdeleRing (𝓞 F) F)ˣ →* Dfx F D :=
  Units.map Algebra.TensorProduct.rightAlgebra.algebraMap.toMonoidHom

/-!
This definition is made in mathlib-generality but is *not* the definition of an automorphic
form unless Dˣ is compact mod centre at infinity. This hypothesis will be true if `D` is a
totally definite quaternion algebra.
-/
structure AutomorphicForm
  -- defined over R
  (R : Type*) [CommRing R]
  -- of weight W
  (W : Type*) [AddCommGroup W] [Module R W] [MulAction Dˣ W]
  -- and level U
  (U : Subgroup (D ⊗[F] (FiniteAdeleRing (𝓞 F) F))ˣ)
  -- and character χ
  (χ : (FiniteAdeleRing (𝓞 F) F)ˣ →* R) where
  -- definition
  toFun : (D ⊗[F] (FiniteAdeleRing (𝓞 F) F))ˣ → W
  left_invt : ∀ (δ : Dˣ) (g : (D ⊗[F] (FiniteAdeleRing (𝓞 F) F))ˣ),
    toFun (incl₁ δ * g) = δ • (toFun g)
  has_character : ∀ (g : (D ⊗[F] (FiniteAdeleRing (𝓞 F) F))ˣ) (z : (FiniteAdeleRing (𝓞 F) F)ˣ),
    toFun (g * incl₂ F D z) = χ z • toFun g
  right_invt : ∀ (g : (D ⊗[F] (FiniteAdeleRing (𝓞 F) F))ˣ),
    ∀ u ∈ U, toFun (g * u) = toFun g

namespace AutomorphicForm

-- defined over R
variable  (R : Type*) [CommRing R]
  -- weight
  (W : Type*) [AddCommGroup W] [Module R W] [DistribMulAction Dˣ W]
  -- NB actions of Dˣ and R should commute
  -- level
  (U : Subgroup (D ⊗[F] (FiniteAdeleRing (𝓞 F) F))ˣ) -- subgroup should be compact and open
  -- character
  (χ : (FiniteAdeleRing (𝓞 F) F)ˣ →* R)

variable {F D R W U χ}

instance : CoeFun (AutomorphicForm F D R W U χ) (fun _ ↦ Dfx F D → W) where
  coe := toFun

attribute [coe] AutomorphicForm.toFun

@[ext]
theorem ext (φ ψ : AutomorphicForm F D R W U χ) (h : ∀ x, φ x = ψ x) : φ = ψ := by
  cases φ; cases ψ; simp only [mk.injEq]; ext; apply h

def zero : (AutomorphicForm F D R W U χ) where
  toFun := 0
  left_invt δ _ := by simp
  has_character _ z := by simp
  right_invt _ u _ := by simp

instance : Zero (AutomorphicForm F D R W U χ) where
  zero := zero

@[simp]
theorem zero_apply (x : (D ⊗[F] (FiniteAdeleRing (𝓞 F) F))ˣ) :
    (0 : AutomorphicForm F D R W U χ) x = 0 := rfl

def neg (φ : AutomorphicForm F D R W U χ) : AutomorphicForm F D R W U χ where
  toFun x := - φ x
  left_invt δ g := by simp [left_invt]
  has_character g z := by simp [has_character]
  right_invt g u hu := by simp_all [right_invt]

instance : Neg (AutomorphicForm F D R W U χ) where
  neg := neg

@[simp, norm_cast]
theorem neg_apply (φ : AutomorphicForm F D R W U χ) (x : (D ⊗[F] (FiniteAdeleRing (𝓞 F) F))ˣ) :
    (-φ : AutomorphicForm F D R W U χ) x = -(φ x) := rfl

instance add (φ ψ : AutomorphicForm F D R W U χ) : AutomorphicForm F D R W U χ where
  toFun x := φ x + ψ x
  left_invt := by simp [left_invt]
  has_character := by simp [has_character]
  right_invt := by simp_all [right_invt]

instance : Add (AutomorphicForm F D R W U χ) where
  add := add

@[simp, norm_cast]
theorem add_apply (φ ψ : AutomorphicForm F D R W U χ) (x : (D ⊗[F] (FiniteAdeleRing (𝓞 F) F))ˣ) :
    (φ + ψ) x = (φ x) + (ψ x) := rfl

instance addCommGroup : AddCommGroup (AutomorphicForm F D R W U χ) where

  add_assoc := by intros; ext; simp [add_assoc];
  zero := 0
  zero_add := by intros; ext; simp
  add_zero := by intros; ext; simp

  neg := (-·)
  zsmul := zsmulRec
  neg_add_cancel := by intros; ext; simp
  add_comm := by intros; ext; simp [add_comm]

/-- The fundamental scalar multiplication in an additive group. `zpowRec n a = a+a+...+a` n
times, for integer `n`. Use instead `n • a`, which has better definitional behavior. -/

  | Int.ofNat n, a => nsmul n a
  | Int.negSucc n, a => -nsmul n.succ a

  | n + 1, a => nsmulRec n a + a

/--
`rfl : a = a` is the unique constructor of the equality type. This is the
same as `Eq.refl` except that it takes `a` implicitly instead of explicitly.

This is a more powerful theorem than it may appear at first, because although
the statement of the theorem is `a = a`, Lean will allow anything that is
definitionally equal to that type. So, for instance, `2 + 2 = 4` is proven in
Lean by `rfl`, because both sides are the same up to definitional equality.
-/
@[match_pattern] def rfl {α : Sort u} {a : α} : Eq a a := Eq.refl a

import FLT.DivisionAlgebra.Finiteness

/-

# Definition of automorphic forms on a totally definite quaternion algebra

-/

suppress_compilation

variable (F : Type*) [Field F] [NumberField F] --[NumberField.IsTotallyReal F]

variable (D : Type*) [Ring D] [Algebra F D] --[IsCentralSimple F D] [FiniteDimensional F D]

namespace TotallyDefiniteQuaternionAlgebra

-- noncomputable example : D →+* (D ⊗[F] FiniteAdeleRing (𝓞 F) F) :=
--   Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeftRingHom

open scoped TensorProduct NumberField

open DedekindDomain

abbrev Dfx := (D ⊗[F] (FiniteAdeleRing (𝓞 F) F))ˣ

variable {F D} in
noncomputable abbrev incl₁ : Dˣ →* Dfx F D :=
  Units.map Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeftRingHom.toMonoidHom

noncomputable abbrev incl₂ : (FiniteAdeleRing (𝓞 F) F)ˣ →* Dfx F D :=
  Units.map Algebra.TensorProduct.rightAlgebra.algebraMap.toMonoidHom

/-!
This definition is made in mathlib-generality but is *not* the definition of an automorphic
form unless Dˣ is compact mod centre at infinity. This hypothesis will be true if `D` is a
totally definite quaternion algebra.
-/
structure AutomorphicForm
  -- defined over R
  (R : Type*) [CommRing R]
  -- of weight W
  (W : Type*) [AddCommGroup W] [Module R W] [MulAction Dˣ W]
  -- and level U
  (U : Subgroup (D ⊗[F] (FiniteAdeleRing (𝓞 F) F))ˣ)
  -- and character χ
  (χ : (FiniteAdeleRing (𝓞 F) F)ˣ →* R) where
  -- definition
  toFun : (D ⊗[F] (FiniteAdeleRing (𝓞 F) F))ˣ → W
  left_invt : ∀ (δ : Dˣ) (g : (D ⊗[F] (FiniteAdeleRing (𝓞 F) F))ˣ),
    toFun (incl₁ δ * g) = δ • (toFun g)
  has_character : ∀ (g : (D ⊗[F] (FiniteAdeleRing (𝓞 F) F))ˣ) (z : (FiniteAdeleRing (𝓞 F) F)ˣ),
    toFun (g * incl₂ F D z) = χ z • toFun g
  right_invt : ∀ (g : (D ⊗[F] (FiniteAdeleRing (𝓞 F) F))ˣ),
    ∀ u ∈ U, toFun (g * u) = toFun g

namespace AutomorphicForm

-- defined over R
variable  (R : Type*) [CommRing R]
  -- weight
  (W : Type*) [AddCommGroup W] [Module R W] [DistribMulAction Dˣ W]
  -- NB actions of Dˣ and R should commute
  -- level
  (U : Subgroup (D ⊗[F] (FiniteAdeleRing (𝓞 F) F))ˣ) -- subgroup should be compact and open
  -- character
  (χ : (FiniteAdeleRing (𝓞 F) F)ˣ →* R)

variable {F D R W U χ}

instance : CoeFun (AutomorphicForm F D R W U χ) (fun _ ↦ Dfx F D → W) where
  coe := toFun

attribute [coe] AutomorphicForm.toFun

@[ext]
theorem ext (φ ψ : AutomorphicForm F D R W U χ) (h : ∀ x, φ x = ψ x) : φ = ψ := by
  cases φ; cases ψ; simp only [mk.injEq]; ext; apply h

def zero : (AutomorphicForm F D R W U χ) where
  toFun := 0
  left_invt δ _ := by simp
  has_character _ z := by simp
  right_invt _ u _ := by simp

import FLT.DivisionAlgebra.Finiteness

/-

# Definition of automorphic forms on a totally definite quaternion algebra

-/

suppress_compilation

variable (F : Type*) [Field F] [NumberField F] --[NumberField.IsTotallyReal F]

variable (D : Type*) [Ring D] [Algebra F D] --[IsCentralSimple F D] [FiniteDimensional F D]

namespace TotallyDefiniteQuaternionAlgebra

-- noncomputable example : D →+* (D ⊗[F] FiniteAdeleRing (𝓞 F) F) :=
--   Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeftRingHom

open scoped TensorProduct NumberField

open DedekindDomain

abbrev Dfx := (D ⊗[F] (FiniteAdeleRing (𝓞 F) F))ˣ

variable {F D} in
noncomputable abbrev incl₁ : Dˣ →* Dfx F D :=
  Units.map Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeftRingHom.toMonoidHom

noncomputable abbrev incl₂ : (FiniteAdeleRing (𝓞 F) F)ˣ →* Dfx F D :=
  Units.map Algebra.TensorProduct.rightAlgebra.algebraMap.toMonoidHom

/-!
This definition is made in mathlib-generality but is *not* the definition of an automorphic
form unless Dˣ is compact mod centre at infinity. This hypothesis will be true if `D` is a
totally definite quaternion algebra.
-/
structure AutomorphicForm
  -- defined over R
  (R : Type*) [CommRing R]
  -- of weight W
  (W : Type*) [AddCommGroup W] [Module R W] [MulAction Dˣ W]
  -- and level U
  (U : Subgroup (D ⊗[F] (FiniteAdeleRing (𝓞 F) F))ˣ)
  -- and character χ
  (χ : (FiniteAdeleRing (𝓞 F) F)ˣ →* R) where
  -- definition
  toFun : (D ⊗[F] (FiniteAdeleRing (𝓞 F) F))ˣ → W
  left_invt : ∀ (δ : Dˣ) (g : (D ⊗[F] (FiniteAdeleRing (𝓞 F) F))ˣ),
    toFun (incl₁ δ * g) = δ • (toFun g)
  has_character : ∀ (g : (D ⊗[F] (FiniteAdeleRing (𝓞 F) F))ˣ) (z : (FiniteAdeleRing (𝓞 F) F)ˣ),
    toFun (g * incl₂ F D z) = χ z • toFun g
  right_invt : ∀ (g : (D ⊗[F] (FiniteAdeleRing (𝓞 F) F))ˣ),
    ∀ u ∈ U, toFun (g * u) = toFun g

import FLT.DivisionAlgebra.Finiteness

/-

# Definition of automorphic forms on a totally definite quaternion algebra

-/

suppress_compilation

variable (F : Type*) [Field F] [NumberField F] --[NumberField.IsTotallyReal F]

variable (D : Type*) [Ring D] [Algebra F D] --[IsCentralSimple F D] [FiniteDimensional F D]

namespace TotallyDefiniteQuaternionAlgebra

-- noncomputable example : D →+* (D ⊗[F] FiniteAdeleRing (𝓞 F) F) :=
--   Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeftRingHom

open scoped TensorProduct NumberField

open DedekindDomain

abbrev Dfx := (D ⊗[F] (FiniteAdeleRing (𝓞 F) F))ˣ

variable {F D} in
noncomputable abbrev incl₁ : Dˣ →* Dfx F D :=
  Units.map Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeftRingHom.toMonoidHom

noncomputable abbrev incl₂ : (FiniteAdeleRing (𝓞 F) F)ˣ →* Dfx F D :=
  Units.map Algebra.TensorProduct.rightAlgebra.algebraMap.toMonoidHom

/-!
This definition is made in mathlib-generality but is *not* the definition of an automorphic
form unless Dˣ is compact mod centre at infinity. This hypothesis will be true if `D` is a
totally definite quaternion algebra.
-/
structure AutomorphicForm
  -- defined over R
  (R : Type*) [CommRing R]
  -- of weight W
  (W : Type*) [AddCommGroup W] [Module R W] [MulAction Dˣ W]
  -- and level U
  (U : Subgroup (D ⊗[F] (FiniteAdeleRing (𝓞 F) F))ˣ)
  -- and character χ
  (χ : (FiniteAdeleRing (𝓞 F) F)ˣ →* R) where
  -- definition
  toFun : (D ⊗[F] (FiniteAdeleRing (𝓞 F) F))ˣ → W
  left_invt : ∀ (δ : Dˣ) (g : (D ⊗[F] (FiniteAdeleRing (𝓞 F) F))ˣ),
    toFun (incl₁ δ * g) = δ • (toFun g)
  has_character : ∀ (g : (D ⊗[F] (FiniteAdeleRing (𝓞 F) F))ˣ) (z : (FiniteAdeleRing (𝓞 F) F)ˣ),
    toFun (g * incl₂ F D z) = χ z • toFun g
  right_invt : ∀ (g : (D ⊗[F] (FiniteAdeleRing (𝓞 F) F))ˣ),
    ∀ u ∈ U, toFun (g * u) = toFun g

namespace AutomorphicForm

-- defined over R
variable  (R : Type*) [CommRing R]
  -- weight
  (W : Type*) [AddCommGroup W] [Module R W] [DistribMulAction Dˣ W]
  -- NB actions of Dˣ and R should commute
  -- level
  (U : Subgroup (D ⊗[F] (FiniteAdeleRing (𝓞 F) F))ˣ) -- subgroup should be compact and open
  -- character
  (χ : (FiniteAdeleRing (𝓞 F) F)ˣ →* R)

variable {F D R W U χ}

instance : CoeFun (AutomorphicForm F D R W U χ) (fun _ ↦ Dfx F D → W) where
  coe := toFun

attribute [coe] AutomorphicForm.toFun

@[ext]
theorem ext (φ ψ : AutomorphicForm F D R W U χ) (h : ∀ x, φ x = ψ x) : φ = ψ := by
  cases φ; cases ψ; simp only [mk.injEq]; ext; apply h

def zero : (AutomorphicForm F D R W U χ) where
  toFun := 0
  left_invt δ _ := by simp
  has_character _ z := by simp
  right_invt _ u _ := by simp

instance : Zero (AutomorphicForm F D R W U χ) where
  zero := zero

@[simp]
theorem zero_apply (x : (D ⊗[F] (FiniteAdeleRing (𝓞 F) F))ˣ) :
    (0 : AutomorphicForm F D R W U χ) x = 0 := rfl

def neg (φ : AutomorphicForm F D R W U χ) : AutomorphicForm F D R W U χ where
  toFun x := - φ x
  left_invt δ g := by simp [left_invt]
  has_character g z := by simp [has_character]
  right_invt g u hu := by simp_all [right_invt]

instance : Neg (AutomorphicForm F D R W U χ) where
  neg := neg

@[simp, norm_cast]
theorem neg_apply (φ : AutomorphicForm F D R W U χ) (x : (D ⊗[F] (FiniteAdeleRing (𝓞 F) F))ˣ) :
    (-φ : AutomorphicForm F D R W U χ) x = -(φ x) := rfl

instance add (φ ψ : AutomorphicForm F D R W U χ) : AutomorphicForm F D R W U χ where
  toFun x := φ x + ψ x
  left_invt := by exact?

/--
`rfl : a = a` is the unique constructor of the equality type. This is the
same as `Eq.refl` except that it takes `a` implicitly instead of explicitly.

This is a more powerful theorem than it may appear at first, because although
the statement of the theorem is `a = a`, Lean will allow anything that is
definitionally equal to that type. So, for instance, `2 + 2 = 4` is proven in
Lean by `rfl`, because both sides are the same up to definitional equality.
-/
@[match_pattern] def rfl {α : Sort u} {a : α} : Eq a a := Eq.refl a

import FLT.DivisionAlgebra.Finiteness

/-

# Definition of automorphic forms on a totally definite quaternion algebra

-/

suppress_compilation

variable (F : Type*) [Field F] [NumberField F] --[NumberField.IsTotallyReal F]

variable (D : Type*) [Ring D] [Algebra F D] --[IsCentralSimple F D] [FiniteDimensional F D]

namespace TotallyDefiniteQuaternionAlgebra

-- noncomputable example : D →+* (D ⊗[F] FiniteAdeleRing (𝓞 F) F) :=
--   Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeftRingHom

open scoped TensorProduct NumberField

open DedekindDomain

abbrev Dfx := (D ⊗[F] (FiniteAdeleRing (𝓞 F) F))ˣ

variable {F D} in
noncomputable abbrev incl₁ : Dˣ →* Dfx F D :=
  Units.map Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeftRingHom.toMonoidHom

noncomputable abbrev incl₂ : (FiniteAdeleRing (𝓞 F) F)ˣ →* Dfx F D :=
  Units.map Algebra.TensorProduct.rightAlgebra.algebraMap.toMonoidHom

/-!
This definition is made in mathlib-generality but is *not* the definition of an automorphic
form unless Dˣ is compact mod centre at infinity. This hypothesis will be true if `D` is a
totally definite quaternion algebra.
-/
structure AutomorphicForm
  -- defined over R
  (R : Type*) [CommRing R]
  -- of weight W
  (W : Type*) [AddCommGroup W] [Module R W] [MulAction Dˣ W]
  -- and level U
  (U : Subgroup (D ⊗[F] (FiniteAdeleRing (𝓞 F) F))ˣ)
  -- and character χ
  (χ : (FiniteAdeleRing (𝓞 F) F)ˣ →* R) where
  -- definition
  toFun : (D ⊗[F] (FiniteAdeleRing (𝓞 F) F))ˣ → W
  left_invt : ∀ (δ : Dˣ) (g : (D ⊗[F] (FiniteAdeleRing (𝓞 F) F))ˣ),
    toFun (incl₁ δ * g) = δ • (toFun g)
  has_character : ∀ (g : (D ⊗[F] (FiniteAdeleRing (𝓞 F) F))ˣ) (z : (FiniteAdeleRing (𝓞 F) F)ˣ),
    toFun (g * incl₂ F D z) = χ z • toFun g
  right_invt : ∀ (g : (D ⊗[F] (FiniteAdeleRing (𝓞 F) F))ˣ),
    ∀ u ∈ U, toFun (g * u) = toFun g

namespace AutomorphicForm

-- defined over R
variable  (R : Type*) [CommRing R]
  -- weight
  (W : Type*) [AddCommGroup W] [Module R W] [DistribMulAction Dˣ W]
  -- NB actions of Dˣ and R should commute
  -- level
  (U : Subgroup (D ⊗[F] (FiniteAdeleRing (𝓞 F) F))ˣ) -- subgroup should be compact and open
  -- character
  (χ : (FiniteAdeleRing (𝓞 F) F)ˣ →* R)

variable {F D R W U χ}

instance : CoeFun (AutomorphicForm F D R W U χ) (fun _ ↦ Dfx F D → W) where
  coe := toFun

attribute [coe] AutomorphicForm.toFun

@[ext]
theorem ext (φ ψ : AutomorphicForm F D R W U χ) (h : ∀ x, φ x = ψ x) : φ = ψ := by
  cases φ; cases ψ; simp only [mk.injEq]; ext; apply h

def zero : (AutomorphicForm F D R W U χ) where
  toFun := 0
  left_invt δ _ := by simp
  has_character _ z := by simp
  right_invt _ u _ := by simp

instance : Zero (AutomorphicForm F D R W U χ) where
  zero := zero

@[simp]
theorem zero_apply (x : (D ⊗[F] (FiniteAdeleRing (𝓞 F) F))ˣ) :
    (0 : AutomorphicForm F D R W U χ) x = 0 := rfl

def neg (φ : AutomorphicForm F D R W U χ) : AutomorphicForm F D R W U χ where
  toFun x := - φ x
  left_invt δ g := by simp [left_invt]
  has_character g z := by simp [has_character]
  right_invt g u hu := by simp_all [right_invt]

instance : Neg (AutomorphicForm F D R W U χ) where
  neg := by exact?

namespace TotallyDefiniteQuaternionAlgebra

-- noncomputable example : D →+* (D ⊗[F] FiniteAdeleRing (𝓞 F) F) :=
--   Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeftRingHom

open scoped TensorProduct NumberField

open DedekindDomain

abbrev Dfx := (D ⊗[F] (FiniteAdeleRing (𝓞 F) F))ˣ

variable {F D} in
noncomputable abbrev incl₁ : Dˣ →* Dfx F D :=
  Units.map Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeftRingHom.toMonoidHom

noncomputable abbrev incl₂ : (FiniteAdeleRing (𝓞 F) F)ˣ →* Dfx F D :=
  Units.map Algebra.TensorProduct.rightAlgebra.algebraMap.toMonoidHom

/-!
This definition is made in mathlib-generality but is *not* the definition of an automorphic
form unless Dˣ is compact mod centre at infinity. This hypothesis will be true if `D` is a
totally definite quaternion algebra.
-/
structure AutomorphicForm
  -- defined over R
  (R : Type*) [CommRing R]
  -- of weight W
  (W : Type*) [AddCommGroup W] [Module R W] [MulAction Dˣ W]
  -- and level U
  (U : Subgroup (D ⊗[F] (FiniteAdeleRing (𝓞 F) F))ˣ)
  -- and character χ
  (χ : (FiniteAdeleRing (𝓞 F) F)ˣ →* R) where
  -- definition
  toFun : (D ⊗[F] (FiniteAdeleRing (𝓞 F) F))ˣ → W
  left_invt : ∀ (δ : Dˣ) (g : (D ⊗[F] (FiniteAdeleRing (𝓞 F) F))ˣ),
    toFun (incl₁ δ * g) = δ • (toFun g)
  has_character : ∀ (g : (D ⊗[F] (FiniteAdeleRing (𝓞 F) F))ˣ) (z : (FiniteAdeleRing (𝓞 F) F)ˣ),
    toFun (g * incl₂ F D z) = χ z • toFun g
  right_invt : ∀ (g : (D ⊗[F] (FiniteAdeleRing (𝓞 F) F))ˣ),
    ∀ u ∈ U, toFun (g * u) = toFun g

namespace AutomorphicForm

-- defined over R
variable  (R : Type*) [CommRing R]
  -- weight
  (W : Type*) [AddCommGroup W] [Module R W] [DistribMulAction Dˣ W]
  -- NB actions of Dˣ and R should commute
  -- level
  (U : Subgroup (D ⊗[F] (FiniteAdeleRing (𝓞 F) F))ˣ) -- subgroup should be compact and open
  -- character
  (χ : (FiniteAdeleRing (𝓞 F) F)ˣ →* R)

variable {F D R W U χ}

instance : CoeFun (AutomorphicForm F D R W U χ) (fun _ ↦ Dfx F D → W) where
  coe := toFun

attribute [coe] AutomorphicForm.toFun

@[ext]
theorem ext (φ ψ : AutomorphicForm F D R W U χ) (h : ∀ x, φ x = ψ x) : φ = ψ := by
  cases φ; cases ψ; simp only [mk.injEq]; ext; apply h

def zero : (AutomorphicForm F D R W U χ) where
  toFun := 0
  left_invt δ _ := by simp
  has_character _ z := by simp
  right_invt _ u _ := by simp

instance : Zero (AutomorphicForm F D R W U χ) where
  zero := zero

@[simp]
theorem zero_apply (x : (D ⊗[F] (FiniteAdeleRing (𝓞 F) F))ˣ) :
    (0 : AutomorphicForm F D R W U χ) x = 0 := rfl

def neg (φ : AutomorphicForm F D R W U χ) : AutomorphicForm F D R W U χ where
  toFun x := - φ x
  left_invt δ g := by simp [left_invt]
  has_character g z := by simp [has_character]
  right_invt g u hu := by simp_all [right_invt]

instance : Neg (AutomorphicForm F D R W U χ) where
  neg := neg

  neg := neg

informal_statement: The space of automorphic forms of type \( F \) over \( D \) with coefficients in \( R \) is a module over the ring \( R \).
informal_proof:
First, we consider the set of automorphic forms \( \text{AutomorphicForm}\ F\ D\ R\ W\ U\ \chi \).

We aim to show that this set forms a module over the ring \( R \). A module is a generalization of the concept of vector spaces, where scalars are taken from a ring instead of a field. The structure of a module requires the existence of two operations:
1. **Addition**: The set should be an abelian group under addition.
2. **Scalar Multiplication**: Scalar multiplication by elements of \( R \) should be defined and satisfy certain axioms.

Specifically, the axioms for module operations are as follows:
1. **Additive Closure**: For any two automorphic forms \( g \) and \( h \), their sum \( g + h \) is also an automorphic form.
2. **Associativity of Addition**: For any automorphic forms \( f \), \( g \), and \( h \), the equation \( (f + g) + h = f + (g + h) \) holds.
3. **Commutativity of Addition**: For any automorphic forms \( f \) and \( g \), the equation \( f + g = g + f \) holds.
4. **Additive Identity**: There exists an automorphic form \( 0 \) such that for any automorphic form \( f \), the equation \( f + 0 = f \) holds.
5. **Additive Inverses**: For every automorphic form \( f \), there exists another automorphic form \( -f \) such that \( f + (-f) = 0 \).
6. **Scalar Multiplication Compatibility**: For any scalar \( r \) in \( R \) and automorphic forms \( f \) and \( g \), the equation \( r \cdot (f + g) = r \cdot f + r \cdot g \) holds.

Specifically, scalar multiplication by \( r \) satisfies the property \( (r \cdot \phi)(g) = r \cdot (\phi(g)) \). This equality holds by the definition of scalar multiplication in the context of automorphic forms and group actions, ensuring that scalar multiplication is compatible with the group operation.

/--
`rfl : a = a` is the unique constructor of the equality type. This is the
same as `Eq.refl` except that it takes `a` implicitly instead of explicitly.

This is a more powerful theorem than it may appear at first, because although
the statement of the theorem is `a = a`, Lean will allow anything that is
definitionally equal to that type. So, for instance, `2 + 2 = 4` is proven in
Lean by `rfl`, because both sides are the same up to definitional equality.
-/
@[match_pattern] def rfl {α : Sort u} {a : α} : Eq a a := Eq.refl a

informal_statement: The `smul` function scales each component of the global section `φ` of an automorphic form by a scalar `r`, resulting in a new automorphic form where every value of `φ` is uniformly multiplied by `r`.
informal_proof: The `smul` function acts by multiplying each component of the global section `φ` by the scalar `r`. Since `φ` is a section of an automorphic form, it transforms consistently under the action of each group element `g`. Scaling each component by `r` preserves this consistency because the transformation property of `φ` under `g` is maintained for each scaled component. Therefore, the result `smul r φ` is another automorphic form that aligns with the original `φ` under the same group actions.

5. **Inverse Element**: Every element `a` has an additive inverse `-a` such that `a + (-a) = 0`, fulfilling the requirement that every element has an inverse within the structure.

6. **Commutativity**: The addition operation is commutative, meaning `a + b = b + a` for any elements `a` and `b`.

variable (D : Type*) [Ring D] [Algebra F D] --[IsCentralSimple F D] [FiniteDimensional F D]

abbrev Dfx := (D ⊗[F] (FiniteAdeleRing (𝓞 F) F))ˣ

variable {F D} in
noncomputable abbrev incl₁ : Dˣ →* Dfx F D :=
  Units.map Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeftRingHom.toMonoidHom

This definition is made in mathlib-generality but is *not* the definition of an automorphic
form unless Dˣ is compact mod centre at infinity. This hypothesis will be true if `D` is a
totally definite quaternion algebra.
-/

  -- defined over R
  (R : Type*) [CommRing R]
  -- of weight W
  (W : Type*) [AddCommGroup W] [Module R W] [MulAction Dˣ W]
  -- and level U
  (U : Subgroup (D ⊗[F] (FiniteAdeleRing (𝓞 F) F))ˣ)
  -- and character χ

  -- definition

  left_invt : ∀ (δ : Dˣ) (g : (D ⊗[F] (FiniteAdeleRing (𝓞 F) F))ˣ),

    toFun (g * incl₂ F D z) = χ z • toFun g
  right_invt : ∀ (g : (D ⊗[F] (FiniteAdeleRing (𝓞 F) F))ˣ),

informal_statement: For any two automorphic forms φ and ψ, and an element x in the space of finite adele rings, the sum of φ and ψ applied to x is equal to the sum of φ applied to x and ψ applied to x.
informal_proof:
To prove that for any automorphic forms φ and ψ and any element x in the space, the sum (φ + ψ) applied to x equals φ applied to x plus ψ applied to x, we proceed as follows:

1. **Definitions**: Consider two automorphic forms φ and ψ defined on the space of automorphic structures, and an element x of the space of tensor products involving the finite adele ring.

2. **Additivity**: By the property of automorphic forms, the sum operation ∥·∥ is linear. This means that for any two automorphic forms φ and ψ, and any scalar x in the space, the sum (φ + ψ)(x) distributes over the addition of the results of φ(x) and ψ(x).

3. **Application**: Applying the sum of φ and ψ to the element x yields:
   \[
   (\varphi + \psi)(x) = \varphi(x) + \psi(x)
   \]
   
4. **Conclusion**: Thus, the additive property holds true for the given automorphic forms and element, confirming the theorem.

For any element \( x \) in the space \( D \otimes_{F} \textit{FiniteAdeleRing}(\mathcal{O}_{F}) \), the negative of the automorphic form \( \varphi \) evaluated at \( x \) is equal to the automorphic form evaluated at the negative of \( x \). In symbols,
\[ (-\varphi)(x) = -(\varphi(x)) \]
informal_proof:
To prove the statement, we start by considering the definition of the automorphic form and its properties. Specifically, we note that \( \varphi \) is an instance of the type `AutomorphicForm`, which inherently satisfies the condition that applying the negative sign to \( \varphi \) results in the negative of applying \( \varphi \) to the element \( x \). This property is enforced by the `simp` tactic in Lean4, ensuring that the equality \( (-\varphi)(x) = -(\varphi(x)) \) holds definitionally.

In other words, the structure of `AutomorphicForm` is such that the action of negating \( \varphi \) corresponds precisely to negating the result of \( \varphi(x) \) within the algebraic structure. Therefore, the equality is a direct consequence of the definitions and does not require further proof.

import FLT.DivisionAlgebra.Finiteness

/-

# Definition of automorphic forms on a totally definite quaternion algebra

-/

suppress_compilation

variable (F : Type*) [Field F] [NumberField F] --[NumberField.IsTotallyReal F]

variable (D : Type*) [Ring D] [Algebra F D] --[IsCentralSimple F D] [FiniteDimensional F D]

namespace TotallyDefiniteQuaternionAlgebra

-- noncomputable example : D →+* (D ⊗[F] FiniteAdeleRing (𝓞 F) F) :=
--   Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeftRingHom

open scoped TensorProduct NumberField

open DedekindDomain

abbrev Dfx := (D ⊗[F] (FiniteAdeleRing (𝓞 F) F))ˣ

variable {F D} in
noncomputable abbrev incl₁ : Dˣ →* Dfx F D :=
  Units.map Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeftRingHom.toMonoidHom

noncomputable abbrev incl₂ : (FiniteAdeleRing (𝓞 F) F)ˣ →* Dfx F D :=
  Units.map Algebra.TensorProduct.rightAlgebra.algebraMap.toMonoidHom

/-!
This definition is made in mathlib-generality but is *not* the definition of an automorphic
form unless Dˣ is compact mod centre at infinity. This hypothesis will be true if `D` is a
totally definite quaternion algebra.
-/
structure AutomorphicForm
  -- defined over R
  (R : Type*) [CommRing R]
  -- of weight W
  (W : Type*) [AddCommGroup W] [Module R W] [MulAction Dˣ W]
  -- and level U
  (U : Subgroup (D ⊗[F] (FiniteAdeleRing (𝓞 F) F))ˣ)
  -- and character χ
  (χ : (FiniteAdeleRing (𝓞 F) F)ˣ →* R) where
  -- definition
  toFun : (D ⊗[F] (FiniteAdeleRing (𝓞 F) F))ˣ → W
  left_invt : ∀ (δ : Dˣ) (g : (D ⊗[F] (FiniteAdeleRing (𝓞 F) F))ˣ),
    toFun (incl₁ δ * g) = δ • (toFun g)
  has_character : ∀ (g : (D ⊗[F] (FiniteAdeleRing (𝓞 F) F))ˣ) (z : (FiniteAdeleRing (𝓞 F) F)ˣ),
    toFun (g * incl₂ F D z) = χ z • toFun g
  right_invt : ∀ (g : (D ⊗[F] (FiniteAdeleRing (𝓞 F) F))ˣ),
    ∀ u ∈ U, toFun (g * u) = toFun g

informal_statement: The `neg` function is an operation that takes an `AutomorphicForm` and returns another `AutomorphicForm` such that when applied to any element, it returns the negative of the original form while preserving all its structural properties.
informal_proof:
By defining `neg φ x := -φ x`, we construct a new `AutomorphicForm` that operates by applying the unary negation to the result of the original form `φ`. The proofs `left_invt`, `right_invt`, and `has_character` demonstrate that this negation does not interfere with the essential properties of the original form. Specifically:

1. `left_invt δ g`: This property ensures that the left inversion is preserved when applying `-φ x`.
2. `right_invt g u hu`: Similarly, the right inversion is also preserved.
3. `has_character g z`: The form retains its fundamental characteristics under the negation.

Thus, `neg` successfully produces a new `AutomorphicForm` that is the negative of the original but maintains all its necessary properties.

import FLT.DivisionAlgebra.Finiteness

/-

# Definition of automorphic forms on a totally definite quaternion algebra

-/

suppress_compilation

variable (F : Type*) [Field F] [NumberField F] --[NumberField.IsTotallyReal F]

variable (D : Type*) [Ring D] [Algebra F D] --[IsCentralSimple F D] [FiniteDimensional F D]

namespace TotallyDefiniteQuaternionAlgebra

-- noncomputable example : D →+* (D ⊗[F] FiniteAdeleRing (𝓞 F) F) :=
--   Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeftRingHom

open scoped TensorProduct NumberField

open DedekindDomain

abbrev Dfx := (D ⊗[F] (FiniteAdeleRing (𝓞 F) F))ˣ

variable {F D} in
noncomputable abbrev incl₁ : Dˣ →* Dfx F D :=
  Units.map Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeftRingHom.toMonoidHom

noncomputable abbrev incl₂ : (FiniteAdeleRing (𝓞 F) F)ˣ →* Dfx F D :=
  Units.map Algebra.TensorProduct.rightAlgebra.algebraMap.toMonoidHom

/-!
This definition is made in mathlib-generality but is *not* the definition of an automorphic
form unless Dˣ is compact mod centre at infinity. This hypothesis will be true if `D` is a
totally definite quaternion algebra.
-/
structure AutomorphicForm
  -- defined over R
  (R : Type*) [CommRing R]
  -- of weight W
  (W : Type*) [AddCommGroup W] [Module R W] [MulAction Dˣ W]
  -- and level U
  (U : Subgroup (D ⊗[F] (FiniteAdeleRing (𝓞 F) F))ˣ)
  -- and character χ
  (χ : (FiniteAdeleRing (𝓞 F) F)ˣ →* R) where
  -- definition
  toFun : (D ⊗[F] (FiniteAdeleRing (𝓞 F) F))ˣ → W
  left_invt : ∀ (δ : Dˣ) (g : (D ⊗[F] (FiniteAdeleRing (𝓞 F) F))ˣ),
    toFun (incl₁ δ * g) = δ • (toFun g)
  has_character : ∀ (g : (D ⊗[F] (FiniteAdeleRing (𝓞 F) F))ˣ) (z : (FiniteAdeleRing (𝓞 F) F)ˣ),
    toFun (g * incl₂ F D z) = χ z • toFun g
  right_invt : ∀ (g : (D ⊗[F] (FiniteAdeleRing (𝓞 F) F))ˣ),
    ∀ u ∈ U, toFun (g * u) = toFun g

abbrev Dfx := (D ⊗[F] (FiniteAdeleRing (𝓞 F) F))ˣ

  Units.map Algebra.TensorProduct.rightAlgebra.algebraMap.toMonoidHom

/-!
This definition is made in mathlib-generality but is *not* the definition of an automorphic
form unless Dˣ is compact mod centre at infinity. This hypothesis will be true if `D` is a
totally definite quaternion algebra.

  -- and character χ

  -- definition
  toFun : (D ⊗[F] (FiniteAdeleRing (𝓞 F) F))ˣ → W
  left_invt : ∀ (δ : Dˣ) (g : (D ⊗[F] (FiniteAdeleRing (𝓞 F) F))ˣ),
    toFun (incl₁ δ * g) = δ • (toFun g)
  has_character : ∀ (g : (D ⊗[F] (FiniteAdeleRing (𝓞 F) F))ˣ) (z : (FiniteAdeleRing (𝓞 F) F)ˣ),
    toFun (g * incl₂ F D z) = χ z • toFun g
  right_invt : ∀ (g : (D ⊗[F] (FiniteAdeleRing (𝓞 F) F))ˣ),
    ∀ u ∈ U, toFun (g * u) = toFun g

import FLT.DivisionAlgebra.Finiteness

/-

# Definition of automorphic forms on a totally definite quaternion algebra

-/

suppress_compilation

variable (F : Type*) [Field F] [NumberField F] --[NumberField.IsTotallyReal F]

variable (D : Type*) [Ring D] [Algebra F D] --[IsCentralSimple F D] [FiniteDimensional F D]

namespace TotallyDefiniteQuaternionAlgebra

-- noncomputable example : D →+* (D ⊗[F] FiniteAdeleRing (𝓞 F) F) :=
--   Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeftRingHom

open scoped TensorProduct NumberField

open DedekindDomain

abbrev Dfx := (D ⊗[F] (FiniteAdeleRing (𝓞 F) F))ˣ

variable {F D} in
noncomputable abbrev incl₁ : Dˣ →* Dfx F D :=
  Units.map Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeftRingHom.toMonoidHom

noncomputable abbrev incl₂ : (FiniteAdeleRing (𝓞 F) F)ˣ →* Dfx F D :=
  Units.map Algebra.TensorProduct.rightAlgebra.algebraMap.toMonoidHom

/-!
This definition is made in mathlib-generality but is *not* the definition of an automorphic
form unless Dˣ is compact mod centre at infinity. This hypothesis will be true if `D` is a
totally definite quaternion algebra.
-/
structure AutomorphicForm
  -- defined over R
  (R : Type*) [CommRing R]
  -- of weight W
  (W : Type*) [AddCommGroup W] [Module R W] [MulAction Dˣ W]
  -- and level U
  (U : Subgroup (D ⊗[F] (FiniteAdeleRing (𝓞 F) F))ˣ)
  -- and character χ
  (χ : (FiniteAdeleRing (𝓞 F) F)ˣ →* R) where
  -- definition
  toFun : (D ⊗[F] (FiniteAdeleRing (𝓞 F) F))ˣ → W
  left_invt : ∀ (δ : Dˣ) (g : (D ⊗[F] (FiniteAdeleRing (𝓞 F) F))ˣ),
    toFun (incl₁ δ * g) = δ • (toFun g)
  has_character : ∀ (g : (D ⊗[F] (FiniteAdeleRing (𝓞 F) F))ˣ) (z : (FiniteAdeleRing (𝓞 F) F)ˣ),
    toFun (g * incl₂ F D z) = χ z • toFun g
  right_invt : ∀ (g : (D ⊗[F] (FiniteAdeleRing (𝓞 F) F))ˣ),
    ∀ u ∈ U, toFun (g * u) = toFun g

informal_statement: For any two propositions \( a \) and \( b \), \( a \land b \) is equivalent to \( b \land a \). The order of propositions in a conjunction does not affect the truth value of the statement.
informal_proof:
Let \( a \) and \( b \) be any two propositions. By definition, \( a \land b \) is true if and only if both \( a \) and \( b \) are true. Since the truth value depends only on the propositions themselves and not on their order, \( b \land a \) is also true under the same conditions. Therefore, \( a \land b \) and \( b \land a \) are equivalent.

The equivalence is bidirectional. If \( a \land b \) is true, then both \( a \) and \( b \) are true, making \( b \land a \) true as well. Conversely, if \( b \land a \) is true, then \( a \) and \( b \) are true, ensuring \( a \land b \) is also true. Thus, the commutativity of conjunction is established.

C1_dependencies.name: Units.map
C1_dependencies.content:
/-- The group homomorphism on units induced by a `MonoidHom`. -/
@[to_additive "The additive homomorphism on `AddUnit`s induced by an `AddMonoidHom`."]
def map (f : M →* N) : Mˣ →* Nˣ :=
  MonoidHom.mk'
    (fun u => ⟨f u.val, f u.inv,
      by rw [← f.map_mul, u.val_inv, f.map_one],
      by rw [← f.map_mul, u.inv_val, f.map_one]⟩)
    fun x y => ext (f.map_mul x y)
